items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: I know, I know the board of them. He's from Robichaud... I used to play no more. Wasn't a musician

ctx.x: Yeah. Well I know, I know the, I know the board of them. He's from Robichaud, they're from, they're from Al Jays. They're from on, uh, I forgot the name of the name of the band. And, uh, Glennie, he used to play with, he used to play with the, do you remember the Robichaud band?
I heard about him, I know young, uh, Joe Robichaud that plays piano. Yeah. But I never did know the violin player.

Yeah. Well I know, I know the board of them. He's from Robichaud, they're from, they're from Al Jays. They're from on, uh, I forgot the name of the street in Al Jays, but they're from Al Jays. One played violin and the other one played trumpet on. I used to play no more. Wasn't a musician, you can, you ain't no musician, you can't call. I don't know. None.
